senses.gloss:
हेलन हेल् + अन, n.
 1. Disregard, Bhāg. P. 1, 19, 2.
 2. Dalliance.

हेला हेल् + आ, f.
 1. Sport, Ratnāv. 2. ed. 17, 11.
 2. Contempt, Śiś. 2, 48.
 3. Dallying, lascivious endearment, delight, Mālat. 157, 19.
 4. Manner, Neriosengh, see Gött. Gel. Anz. 1861, p. 1837.
 5. instr. लया (properly, Sportively, easily; cf. लीला), At once, Pañc. ii. d. 80; 106, 1; 134, 13; 168, 6; Rājat. 5, 84.
 --Comp.

हेलि हेल् + इ, m.
 1. The sun (borrowed from ἥλιος), Bhaviṣyap., see Aufrecht, Ujjvalad. 267, n.
 2. Embracing.
हेलुदिण्ण हेलु-दिण्ण (हेलु, The name of a village, and दिण्ण, the [] Prākṛt. form for दत्त), adj. Presented with the village हेलु, Rājat. 5, 397.
